milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate near the sandstone slab trail and face it, confirming visual discovery. Target is the center of the 4-slab diagonal trail at spawn-relative (5, 0, 4). Max distance reduced to 5 (from original 16) per CommonSenseAgent feedback: since slabs start at ~3.6 blocks from spawn, max_distance=5 ensures the player must actually walk toward the slabs rather than trivially satisfying the condition by looking from spawn. Facing_tolerance=60 requires the player to be looking in the general direction of the slabs.

Uses inventory_has because this is a mine task — acacia stairs drop themselves as an item when mined with any axe. The player starts with a wooden axe and no acacia_stairs in inventory, so having min_count=1 confirms at least one acacia_stairs block was successfully mined and collected. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory.
